summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, then analyzing them via Ouroboros and Mycelium to close a self-improvement loop. Scale the system to run overnight continuously.
summary.outcome: Delivered a validated closed-loop Mycelium feedback system (E1-E63): discovered and fixed a critical SET-semantics bug in `apply_mycelium_feedback` (E57), validated the convergence formula `consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125*(1-lr/2)^n`, committed the production fix with 11 regression tests, and established an autoresearch loop with proper experimental methodology (retirement criterion, V-model invariants, pre-specified falsification). SurrealDB persistence was fixed from simulation to real HTTP. Over 40,000 experiment runs accumulated in autoresearch.jsonl.

repo: SurrealQL does not support `SELECT 1;` — must use `RETURN true;` as the health probe
SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary subfields in TYPE object fields even with explicit assignment; variable EVO biography data must go in an option<string> `result` field as JSON
SurrealDB datetime fields require `time::now()` — string literals like '2026-05-01T21:00:00Z' are rejected
`string::starts_with` is not supported in this SurrealDB version
`run_llm_deliberation()` unconditionally SETs `_score_adjustments[vt]` on every call — experiments must call `nexus.deliberate()` directly to preserve Mycelium calibration
E47 voice profile experiments must modify `_mycelium_calibration`, not `_score_adjustments`, because `run_llm_deliberation` overwrites `_score_adjustments` every deliberation
SCHEDULE labels ('E55_mycelium') must exactly match experiment strings passed to `log_result` ('E55') for the retirement criterion to fire
Pre-commit playwright hook runs unconditionally with no `files:` filter — needs `files: '\.(tsx?|jsx?|css|html)$'` to avoid blocking Python-only commits
Gemini worktrees get cleaned up automatically; code in worktrees that is not committed to main-repo branches is permanently lost
JEPA `surprise_score` was being called as `surprise_score(state, action, action)` — action passed as both action and observed_next — producing meaningless surprise scores for 450+ runs

ManifoldEnv `verifiable` reward: `r_hiho = 1 - 4*var(position)`, peaks at 1.0 when all 12 dims = 0.5; `hiho_time_ratio` is more informative than `mean_final_deviation` for comparing convergence quality
asyncio.wait_for with a negative timeout argument enters an immediate tight spin loop — must guard with `max(30.0, remaining_s - 10)`
The Mycelium synthesized skill format uses `'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX'` pattern (output of `_synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill`), not `voice_scores=[...]` (input to `ingest_evo_journeys`)
IEEE 754: `sum([0.85]*10)/10 < 0.85` — use `result.approved` (direct threshold comparison) as the canonical crossing check, not float mean

code.finding: E57 fix: `apply_mycelium_feedback` had SET semantics (`_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment`) causing cycle 2 to decay. Fixed by splitting into persistent `_mycelium_calibration` (+=) and per-deliberation `_score_adjustments` (= calibration value). `_mycelium_calibration` initialized as `dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0)` in `__init__`.

`_evaluate_resource` only checked `budget_available` context flag, ignoring description text. Extended with +0.10 bonus for keywords ('cost', 'budget', 'efficient', 'resource', 'reduce') to match real LLM scoring behavior.

`connect()` was entirely simulated — set `self.connected = True` without any HTTP call. Rewrote to use real httpx probe with `RETURN true;`. All CREATE statements changed to use `time::now()` for datetime fields. EVO biography data moved to `result` (option<string>) field.

Worker loop never started in overnight loop (missing `await bus.start()` + `await worker.start()` in `main()`). Also manually pulled events from queue before worker could process them — added direct `db.insert_flume_journey_event(evt)` after manual pull.

Added `ingest_evo_journeys(event_metadata_list)` converting FlumeJourneyEvent.metadata to JournalEntry with domain='evo_deliberation'. Added `_synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill()` extracting per-voice means via regex on 'voice_scores=[architect=0.850 ...]' format.

Added `check_journey_anomaly(evo_biographies, consensus_threshold=0.85)` detecting EVOs with evo_coherence < 0.50, consuming ExecutionExhaust, triggering healing. However, wires incorrectly to experimental data — 320 false-alarm HIHO drift events during this session.

New file: 11 regression tests guarding E57 production fix. Tests: `_mycelium_calibration` in `__init__`, mechanism is 'additive_calibration', cycle 2 does not decay (E56 regression guard), monotonic compounding over 5 cycles (E57), calibration converges toward gap (E59), single cycle lifts consensus ≥0.05 (E55), lr=2.0 crosses threshold (E60), full pipeline lifts deliberation (E62).

Added `_check_retirement()` using CV of last 10 keep metrics < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 (attractor retirement) OR 0% keep with n_runs >= min_runs (noise retirement). Normalizes SCHEDULE label 'E12_persist' to experiment key 'E12' via split on '_'[0]. Validated against 6500+ run history — correctly retires only E12.

New 2-hour timed driver using `timeit.default_timer()`. Fixed spin-loop bug: `asyncio.wait_for(coro, timeout=remaining_s - 10)` passes negative value near deadline. Fix: `if remaining_s < 30: break` guard plus `max(30.0, remaining_s - 10)` for timeout. Keep inference checked wrong key ('delta' vs 'coherence_trajectory' for E12).

Inversion test used geometrically ambiguous data: `[[0,1],[1,0]] -> [[1,0],[0,1]]` is solved by both `invert` and `flip_h`. DFS returns first match. Fixed by using 3x3 data only solvable by inversion.

workflow: Retirement criterion (CV < 0.05 after 20 keeps OR 0% keep after 20 runs) is essential to prevent convergent experiments from running indefinitely — E51 ran 4,786 times without it
Proper experimental design requires pre-specified hypothesis, null hypothesis, and falsification criterion before running — E50 and E54 needed 2-3 redesigns due to no upfront metric specification
Always call `nexus.deliberate()` directly (not `run_llm_deliberation()`) when testing Mycelium feedback — the latter wipes `_score_adjustments` every call
timeit.default_timer() (wraps time.perf_counter) is the correct choice for experiment wall-clock timing — unaffected by NTP corrections
Pre-commit ruff format hook requires running `ruff format` then re-staging before committing — never commit a file that ruff would reformat
Autodata bimodal signal (0% keep for ceiling/noise experiments, 100% keep for signal experiments) is the correct output of a well-calibrated filter — don't try to fix 0%-keep experiments
The Gemini worktree is not a safe place to do serious development — always commit work to main repo branches before it can be lost to worktree cleanup
Log experiment results to vault (observations.jsonl) as they are confirmed, not as a batch at the end — worktree cleanup wiped unvaulted session context
When SurrealDB writes appear to succeed silently, test with a direct count query immediately after — the client can report connected=True while the INSERT fails schema validation

friction: Gemini worktree `.gemini/worktrees/2026-05-02-03-57-33-561-fvqr/` was cleaned up automatically, permanently losing the 3500-line E55-E62 overnight loop rewrite — all those experiments had to be reconstructed
pyproject.toml had unresolved 3-way merge conflicts between HEAD and `isolated/session-oom-modularity` that blocked every `uv run` command until manually resolved
ruff format pre-commit hook silently reformatted files after every Edit, requiring re-stage + retry — Edit → ruff formats → hook fails → format → re-stage → commit was the actual flow every time

Multiple concurrent overnight loop and autorun_2h processes accumulated across restarts — PIDs had to be tracked manually and processes killed explicitly
SurrealDB had four separate incompatibilities discovered sequentially: wrong probe query, string timestamps, undeclared metadata subfields, missing required SCHEMAFULL fields
E11 JEPA API misuse (`surprise_score(state, action, action)`) ran for 450+ iterations across 10+ sessions before being caught — no API contract enforcement
SCHEDULE label vs experiment name mismatch ('E55_mycelium' vs 'E55') caused retirement criterion to never fire for an entire session until the bug was found
asyncio.wait_for spin-loop consumed CPU at session deadline — the 2-hour session entered a tight cycle in its final minutes generating thousands of timeout log lines
E60 monitor was flooded with 'Phase B:' print lines from the experiment body — monitor pattern matched every print, not just the summary line
An interactive rebase was started by a concurrent process on the working branch while committing — required `git rebase --abort` and branch reattachment

The inflation bug (cycle 1 consensus=0.950 artificial) ran for a full E7 LLM cycle (~55 min) before diagnosis — the additive accumulation of per-deliberation LLM adjustments was invisible until comparing the heuristic baseline
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered silent failure state mid-session (returns empty string for all evaluation prompts) — required functional probe to detect and fallback to heuristic mode
open_items: `apply_mycelium_feedback` has zero production callers in src/ — the E57 fix is deployed but the feedback loop is never invoked in the production compound executor; needs wiring into CompoundExecutor

Ouroboros fires 320+ HIHO drift events on experimental EVO lifecycle resets (vacuum→dissolving between phases) as false alarms — needs a flag or context to distinguish experimental from production EVOs

Mycelium synthesized skills are local instances per experiment run and never accumulate into the production MyceliumRegistry — a shared persistent registry across sessions was designed but the code was in the lost Gemini worktree
SurrealDB `experiment_runs` table is empty (0 records) — the HTTP-direct write code for experiment persistence was in the lost Gemini worktree and was not re-implemented
E63 lr=2.0 in LLM mode was started but the 2-hour deadline cut off before confirmation — delta=+0.1250 was only confirmed in heuristic mode
E64 (multi-cycle Mycelium compounding: predicted trajectory 0.725→0.788→0.819→0.835→0.842→0.846→0.850+) is in the schedule but has no confirmed runs yet
280 pre-existing test failures remain in the full pytest suite — root cause not investigated
